cohort: Patients with fetal death after 28 weeks of pregnancy until 7 days after neonatal birth at a tertiary care center in India from January 1, 2019, to December 31, 2019.
finding: Prematurity, low birth weight, improper newborn wrapping, and lack of maternal guidance and training were significantly associated with higher neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Of the 100 neonates born after labor induction, 88 were delivered vaginally and 12 by cesarean section, while 69 neonatal deaths (21.83%) occurred in patients who underwent cesarean section.
birth_weight: low birth weight (mentioned as a risk factor but no specific range given)
